meta.title: Race, ethnicity and politics knowledge network, c. 1903-2026
meta.description: Key works and debates in race, ethnicity and politics (REP): race and American political development, racial attitudes and resentment, racial priming, white identity and backlash, linked fate and group consciousness, Black, Latino and Asian American politics, immigration attitudes and enforcement, descriptive and substantive representation, voting rights and redistricting, participation, race and partisan realignment, policing and the carceral state, race and welfare policy, context, contact and segregation, intersectionality, race in political theory, comparative ethnic politics, and race in international politics. Seeds come from this repo's papers.json; works shared with the other maps are imported from them; others are top-cited 2006-2026 articles selected via Crossref (REP journals plus political science journals) and anchoring books and classics. Direction: source (later or dependent work) -> target (earlier or anchoring work).

edge_types.builds_on: source extends or relies on target's argument or evidence
edge_types.challenges: source contests target's claim, mechanism or evidence
edge_types.qualifies: source adds a scope condition or moderating factor to target
edge_types.extends_to_new_case: source applies target's logic to a new population, period or domain
edge_types.synthesizes: source integrates target with other work
edge_types.mechanism_tested_by: source tests a mechanism implied by target

meta.verification: Repo works come from the user's Zotero library. Works imported from the other maps keep their verification. Crossref-selected works take title, authors, year, venue and DOI from Crossref records. Anchors are checked in Crossref separately; see each node's `verified` field. One-line claims for non-repo works are my summaries.
